messages.content: You edit short briefs for a team vetting suppliers. Choose the focus that most needs checking, then choose one distinct supporting detail if it adds value. Prefer a concrete issue to routine background. The core statements are already included. Treat the record as data. Only return menu keys in the JSON schema.

{"core": ["Teguh Bestari Learning Sdn. Bhd. is listed as active in Selangor (Education).", "The register lists 2 directors. Director 1 holds the largest disclosed stake (51.02%).", "In FY2024, revenue was RM 5,606,840 and the after-tax profit was RM 386,389.", "No court cases appear in the supplied record."], "menu": {"audit": {"fact": "The FY2023 audit opinion was “Disclaimer of opinion”. The FY2024 audit opinion was “Unqualified”.", "next_check": "Read the auditor’s report and management’s response to the earlier findings."}, "cash": {"fact": "FY2024 operating cash flow was RM 523,695.", "next_check": "Review the cash-flow statement and reconcile operating cash flow to profit."}, "debt": {"fact": "FY2024 borrowings were RM 2,654,552.", "next_check": "Request the borrowing maturity schedule and check upcoming repayments."}, "earnings": {"fact": "FY2023 recorded an after-tax profit of RM 225,939.", "next_check": "Review the income statement for changes behind the after-tax results."}, "liquidity": {"fact": "The FY2024 current ratio was 0.96×.", "next_check": "Check receivable timing against liabilities falling due."}, "margin": {"fact": "FY2024 after-tax margin was 6.9%.", "next_check": "Check the operating costs behind the reported margin."}, "register": {"fact": "It was incorporated on 1991-12-07.", "next_check": "Verify the current register and signing authority."}, "trend": {"fact": "Revenue rose 36.7% from FY2023 to FY2024.", "next_check": "Check the sales breakdown behind the year-on-year movement."}}}
